facts.value: Make a difference in K–12 classrooms as a special education teacher. Arizona State University’s online Master of Education in special education prepares you to support students with mild-moderate disabilities. You'll graduate ready to create learning environments that empower students with special needs and build a meaningful career in education.

facts.value: Coursework explores various topics, including instructional methods, assessment strategies, special education law and ethics and language and literacy development. The program culminates in an applied research project, where you’ll identify an educational challenge and design an intervention to address it in the classroom.
